field.scope: occupied records in the fixed 400-slot scroll inventory

support_cases.name: misclassified-ui-entry
support_cases.symptom: record rendered as equipment but remained playable as a scroll

support_cases.name: hidden-from-game-inventory
support_cases.symptom: records were visible to the application scanner but absent in game
support_cases.controlled_changes: two uint16 key values plus save checksum

product_rule: Preserve the first occupied instance of a key, repair later collisions, and assign every new record a fresh nonzero uint16 key.
